column1: # Documentation:    Definition of constaints related to feature CB009915-B
#                   0.5        FB2327    vincent.boulet@nokia.com              Increase coverage by adding new counters
#                   1.0        FB2417    vincent.boulet@nokia.com              Change constraints since activation by default of PRB Pooling feature
#                   1.1        FB2419    vincent.boulet@nokia.com              Change constraints since deactivation by default of PRB Pooling
#                   1.2        FB2425    vincent.boulet@nokia.com              Reduce constraint min for M55308C29005
# After feature activation, the following counters are decreased, as clarified in previous section:
# + M55308C29003 'PRBs used for PDSCH for BWP2' (if two BWPs are configured)
# Also, in case of activation this feature together with BB pooling features, the following counters are decreased:
# + M55308C10005 'PRBs available for PDSCH with L1 baseband pooling activated'
# + M55308C10006 'PRBs available for PUSCH with L1 baseband pooling activated'
# Additionally, assuming the same traffic profile, many other counters related to capacity and performance might be slightly impacted. Including,
# the following for which value shall not be higher after feature activation in comparison to configuration with deactivated feature:
# + M55308C17001 'Accumulated number of Scheduled (FDM and MU-MIMO) UEs on PDSCH per slot'
# + M55308C17002 'Maximum number of Scheduled (FDM and MU-MIMO) UEs on PDSCH per slot'
# + M55308C18001 'Accumulated number of Scheduled (FDM and MU-MIMO) UEs on PUSCH per slot'
# + M55308C18002 'Maximum number of Scheduled (FDM and MU-MIMO) UEs on PUSCH per slot'
# + M55139C02502 'The number of admission successes due to BWP2 selected for SA'
# + M55308C28005 'Accumulated number of UEs scheduled in DL per slot per BWP2'
# + M55308C28006 'Maximum number of UEs scheduled in DL per slot per BWP2'
# In result, all related KPIs are impacted as well.
